content_sections.body: Start with the model: 'These shoes are too small; could I try the larger pair, please?' Replace one detail with your own information about changing shoes at a shop. Then add a short follow-up or reason. This builds the skill to ask for a quantity, price, or alternative in a short transaction.
content_sections.title: Build a useful turn (8 minutes)

content_sections.body: Partner A begins a realistic exchange about changing shoes at a shop. Partner B asks for one missing detail. Swap roles and make one change to the time, place, reason, quantity, or next action. Check that the exchange achieves: Ask for a quantity, price, or alternative in a short transaction.
content_sections.title: Guided dialogue (8 minutes)

content_sections.body: Create a short message about changing shoes at a shop without reading the model. Include a main event or plan and one precise detail. Speak it once slowly, then once at a natural pace. Listen for whether the key information is clear.
content_sections.title: Independent response (6 minutes)
